For severe ischemic and hemorrhagic strokes, hospitals with comprehensive Stroke Centers are required. prompt: What phone plan is best for a family of four in the US?
answer:
When choosing a phone plan for a family of four in the US the most important factors are the number of lines and amount of data needed by the family. All US carriers (AT&T, T-Mobile, Verizon) offer large family plan discounts for households adding multiple lines on the same plan so a minimum of four lines (often with discounts for adding a 5th) is needed for a family of four to get the best pricing. Consider the number of phones in use by each family member, often the parent's lines and a dedicated line for a family member's TV or home internet needs (known as Emergency Broadband Benefit or EBB), and totaling four or more lines needed for the discount. 

For the data plan itself, all carriers offer individual data plans per line usually under 40GB and then shared data pools to cover any excess usage across all lines included. When selecting a family plan with a shared data pool consider the quality of the carriers network in your home and areas you frequent to avoid any dropped calls or poor data speeds. If price is the highest priority T-Mobile is often the least expensive option for a family of four whereas Verizon is often the carrier with the best network quality. AT&T is known for a balance between pricing and network quality and can be a suitable choice for a family of 4 as well. 

Whichever option is chosen make sure to read the fine print of any contract agreement or discounted pricing terms to ensure you understand what services you are paying for and that you have the right plan for your family needs.

answer:
Recent research has found that the most effective aid organizations to donate to are GiveDirectly, Against Malaria Foundation, and Evidence Action's Deworm the World Initiative. All three are charities that work in developing countries.

- GiveDirectly provides direct financial support to people living in extreme poverty, allowing them to make decisions and use resources that best fit their needs. Evidence suggests that such unconditional cash transfers can improve income, food consumption, and assets, with long-term benefits to recipients and their communities. GiveWell, an independent nonprofit organization, has listed GiveDirectly as its top-ranked charity for several years due to its strong evidence base and low overhead costs.

- Against Malaria Foundation distributes long-lasting insecticidal nets (LLINs) to help families in sub-Saharan Africa combat malaria, a preventable disease. Raising awareness and improving LLIN usage are crucial to malaria prevention, as there is no vaccine available. The World Health Organization has recommended LLINs as the primary tool for preventing malaria, and the Against Malaria Foundation has a proven track record of delivering nets in a cost-effective and impactful manner. Over their lifetime, the nets distributed by Against Malaria Foundation have saved an estimated three to seven lives for every dollar spent.

- Evidence Action's Deworm the World Initiative works with governments to implement and scale up school-based deworming programs, which treat and prevent parasitic worms among children. Parasitic worms weaken and impair children, leading to significant health problems and long-term consequences. Research indicates that school-based deworming can significantly improve children's cognition and long-term learning outcomes while reducing health costs and boosting future earnings. Evidence Action's Deworm the World Initiative has supported programs in more than 30 countries, reaching millions of children. It has been called a 'model global health program' by experts.

These charities have a proven record at reducing child deaths and their own administration are very efficient, meaning the majority of the money you donate will be used on the program you support

For a beginner, it is recommended to purchase the best shoe that fits your foot's gait. Gait determines how your heel makes contact with the ground and can be put into one of three categories: neutral, overpronation, underpronation (supination.)

Neutral gait is when your heel lands on the ground with the entire heel in contact and then rolls onto your forefoot. Overpronation is when the heel lands with the outside of the heel and then rolls to the forefoot and then inward, placing more pressure on your foot's inner arch. Underpronation is when the heel lands toward the inner part of the heel and then rolls to the forefoot without rolling inward, placing more pressure on your foot's outer arch.

For standard neutral pronation, shoes such as Nike React Infinity Run Flyknit 2, Brooks Ghost 14, and Adidas Ultraboost 21 are great options. 

For overpronation, shoes such as Adidas Adizero Boston 8, Brooks Adrenaline GTS 21, and Hoka Bondi 7 are very supportive of the foot's medial arch and great options.

Once you have listed out all the plans offered by each provider, it becomes easier to compare the total expected annual cost across a two-year and a three-year contract period while taking into account any upfront discounts, renewal discounts, and penalties for early contract termination (especially if you brought your devices from another provider).
